title: Miami Street Art & Sweet Treats Food Tour: Donuts, Churros & More
blurb:
Explore the vibrant streets of Miami’s Wynwood neighborhood on a delicious adventure that blends art, culture, and irresistible sweets. We’ll kick things off at The Salty Donut, one of Miami’s most beloved bakeries, where you’ll sample a variety of their famous handcrafted flavors, each one as beautiful as the murals surrounding you.

From there, we’ll wander deeper into Wynwood’s colorful corridors, enjoying a warm guava and cheese croissant paired with rich, freshly brewed coffee before indulging in fluffy mini-bao drizzled with creamy condensed milk. Along the way, your guide will share stories of how this once-industrial district transformed into one of the most creative corners of Miami, filled with local art, energy, and personality.

To top off the experience, guests are invited to take part in a live graffiti demonstration, an unforgettable chance to add their own touch to Wynwood’s artistic landscape. Perfect for food lovers, art enthusiasts, and curious explorers alike.
